findings.title: Preprocessing fitted before a holdout split
findings.explanation: A supported static data-flow pattern was observed. Review the intended evaluation protocol; this is not a proof of invalid model performance.
findings.suggestion: Split raw data first; fit preprocessing on training only and transform the held-out set.

coverage.scope: Straight-line module/notebook source order; known sklearn/imblearn APIs. No code execution.

limitations: Static patterns require protocol review; no findings is not a leakage-free certification.
Function bodies, control flow, custom transformers/helpers and cross-file execution are not followed.
Notebook source order can differ from execution order; cells are never executed.
No temporal, target-derived-feature, semantic or foundation-model contamination checks.
